input.summary: Limit Vendor audits to once per 12 months on 30 days' written notice, in business hours, off-site where possible, by a confidentiality-bound independent auditor, and remove remote system access.
input.comment: [Playbook] We cannot accept audits at any time without notice or remote access to our systems, which also contradicts § 22.2. We have limited audits to once per 12 months on 30 days' written notice, during business hours, off-site where possible and by an independent auditor bound by confidentiality; the existing cost allocation and no-direct-access protections in § 22.2 are unchanged.

ops.oldText: 22.1 Vendor may audit Customer at any time without notice and may remotely access Customer's systems and records for that purpose.
ops.newText: 22.1 Vendor may audit Customer not more than once per 12 months, on 30 days' written notice, during business hours, off-site where possible, by an independent auditor bound by confidentiality obligations.
